input.quote: 8.2 Each Order Form has the initial term stated in it and thereafter renews for successive twelve-month periods unless Customer gives Vendor at least thirty days' written notice of non-renewal. Vendor shall remind Customer of an upcoming renewal at least sixty days beforehand.
input.rationale: Renewal terms sit at the preferred position. § 8.2 provides automatic renewals of successive twelve-month periods (no multi-year auto-renewal), a Customer opt-out on only thirty days' written notice (well inside the 30-day preferred window), and an express Vendor reminder at least sixty days before renewal, with the opt-out deadline extended if the reminder is missed — a Customer-favourable addition. § 8.3 caps renewal uplift at the lesser of CPI over the preceding twelve months and three percent, with ninety days' notice and no increase on prepaid periods. Every preferred element is satisfied, so no redline is warranted.

mappings.element: Renewal requires mutual written agreement unless every conditional automatic-renewal element below is met.
